info.title: fason
info.description: Generates optimized and Thoth-compatible JSON encoders and decoders for F# types. Compatible with Fable.

options.name: --namespace
options.description:
Namespace of the generated code (default: <ProjectName>.Serialization).
Only allowed with a single project.

options.name: --output
options.description:
File to write, or a directory that Fason.Generated.fs gets written in
(default: Fason.Generated.fs next to the project). Only allowed with a single project.

options.name: --configuration
options.description:
Build configuration to load the projects with (default: Debug).
Referenced projects must already be built in this configuration.

options.name: --hermes
options.description: Emit code optimized for the Hermes JS engine

options.name: --watch
options.description: Keep running and regenerate when a source file of any loaded project changes

options.name: --version
options.description:
Print the tool version
The FasonNamespace and FasonOutput MSBuild properties of a project set the same things per project.
A relative FasonOutput is resolved against the project directory.
